items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 June 2026 11:19am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, with various fronts affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally force 7 in the west for a time this afternoon and early evening, but remaining southwest 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area. Then becoming south or southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the west this afternoon and evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, outbreaks of rain spreading from the west this evening, becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain for a time.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
